works.overview: Bruce returns as Batman.
Alfred Pennyworth narrates the origin of Batman.
Alfred Pennyworth narrates the origin of Batman.
Red Hood and Onyx take down some of Black Hand's men. Batman goes to Metropolis to talk to Superman about death.

Bruce and Gordon both arrive in Gotham on missions that are sure to put their paths on a collision course. Gordon joins the GCPD which is rife with corruption and he is taught a savage lesson when he tries to buck this new system. Bruce tries out his years of training in a simple street brawl that does not go as planned. Wounded and searching for inspiration, Bruce finds it as a bat flies through the window.

Jason's teacher chides him for his lack of after school activities and Jason regrets not being able to do more. Three students ask him to help as a stagehand that afternoon. They show him how to navigate the school using the catwalks. They intend to change their grades in a locked office but run out of time and promise to meet later. Jason arrives early and sees them making the change. As he wonders what Batman would do, he remembers Bruce telling him, "let the criminals trip themselves up." The next day it's revealed the administration has caught the error and identified the perpetrators.
Batman must stop a breakout at Arkham Asylum and also protect the lives of a reporter and his cameraman.
Bruce Wayne's parents are murdered by a cheap crook, and young Bruce vows to avenge their deaths by warring on all criminals.

Batman examines the coffin that Jason Todd was buried in, looking for any clue that would lead him to what happened to Jason's body.  Flashback to history of Batman and Robin during the time when Jason Todd was Robin.
Alfred decides to try an acting career.
Bruce Wayne goes to the opera with Selina Kyle, Leslie Thompkins and Thomas Elliot, but Harley Quinn robs the public!  Thomas Elliot won't let himself be robbed.

Bruce and Gordon both arrive in Gotham on missions that are sure to put their paths on a collision course. Gordon joins the GCPD which is rife with corruption and he is taught a savage lesson when he tries to buck this new system. Bruce tries out his years of training in a simple street brawl that does not go as planned. Wounded and searching for inspiration, Bruce finds it as a bat flies through the window.
Bruce Wayne goes to the opera with Selina Kyle, Leslie Thompkins and Thomas Elliot, but Harley Quinn robs the public!  Thomas Elliot won't let himself be robbed.
Batman and Robin track down the serial killer known as Faceless.
Batman and Robin travel back in time to the 1860's to investigate the existence of the Black Bat.

Learning the Joker is hospitalized with wounds, the members of the Crime Syndicate make plans to rescue him to lead their mob again. But the Joker has planned a double-cross and the appearance of the Cat-Woman complicates matters.
The Penguin takes in Harold, a deformed genius, who builds a device that gives Penguin the ability to control birds, which he uses to cause the birds to attack various targets in Gotham.

The Caped Crusaders must stop the likes of the Puppet Master, who has set his sights on stealing the Voss Rifle, the Army's newly developed secret gun. But to do it, Batman must overcome the effects of having come under the hypnotic influence of his foe.
Tim mourns his mother and feels he is ready to be Robin, but Batman disagrees. Meanwhile, something is causing ordinary people to suddenly go on murderous rampages.
The Joker organizes a crime circus that performs at the homes of wealthy patrons to size up the joint, then later robs them.
Batman and Robin are chasing Willy the Sap and his gang when they hide in an amusement park.

With the help of some new partners in crime, the Joker sets up a gambling ship for the rich and wealthy, hoping to get them drunk so that they can be pumped for information about their valuable jewels.
Two wealthy men are kidnapped and tortured.  Batman must figure out how they are connected and track down the person responsible.

Convict Chick Miller has been paroled from prison, but doesn't realize that it was part of an operation to get men out in order to serve a mysterious "boss". When Miller balks at the option, he is shot, but Batman rescues him and gets him to the hospital, but still has to be on the lookout because the "boss" wishes to have Miller killed before he can sing about this racket.

The Joker organizes a new gang by advertising for practical jokers in the newspaper, and when they show up, they touch objects used in major crimes, thereby implicating themselves...and forcing them to work for the Crime Prince of Crime!

From prison, Big Mike Russo is able to have his gang kidnap the warden, replace him and the guards with a look alike, then use the prison as a base of operations to commit crimes while providing alibis to those committing them! Batman figures that the only way to uncover this scenario is to get put in prison himself, a move that almost costs him his life in the gas chamber!

When four fugitives steal a large ruby from the turban of Jaffeer, he casts a terrible curse of four fates upon each of the crooks. The Caped Crusaders attempt to capture each of the four, but the curse works on each in most unusual ways.

For his birthday, Dick received his own version of the Batplane, and while aloft, he and Batman run into a storm, which forces them to make an emergency landing on an island inhabited by prehistoric men and creatures.
The Joker escapes from prison and places ads each day in the newspaper to advertize to Batman and Robin his latest criminal pursuit.

While visiting their trophy room, the Caped Crusaders come across a bullet-proof vest, a keepsake from a case involving the Rafferty Brothers, who unwittingly implicated their brother Peter in a murder.
Dick is rudely shocked when Bruce literally kicks him out of the house, not knowing that the Thumb has threatened to kill the Boy Wonder if Batman doesn't lay off.
Batman is among a handful of famed detectives that are invited to a conference, during which famed detective, Dana Drye, is shot and killed before their eyes.

Selina Kyle wins a beauty contest under an assumed name and falls in love with Bruce Wayne, who was one of the judges. Although she is planning capers involving her job in a beauty salon, Selina confesses to Batman that she'd give up her criminal behavior if she knew for certain that she'd have a chance with Wayne.

After robbing a jewelry store, the Joker crash-lands his escape plane and loses his memory. He stumbles into a town where he becomes a hero...but not to the other members of his gang, who seek the jewels, and come looking for him, as do the Caped Crusaders.

Boswell Browne wants to document the exploits of Batman and Robin for future generations, but when members of the underworld hear him bragging to some children that he knows many secrets of the Dynamic Duo, a nefarious criminal decides to use Browne's knowledge against our heroes.

Batman and Robin, in their everyday identities as Bruce Wayne and Dick Grayson (accompanied by Alfred), are investigating Hunter's Inn, the scene of many robberies of wealthy patrons...and run smack into the infamous Tweed Brothers!

After witnessing the fatal injuries to a top notch newspaper reporter who was kidnapped by a gang wanting to keep him silent about their activities, Batman and Robin decide to take over the story and bring the gang to justice.
The Joker enlists the aid of a fraudulent scientist and swami, convincing them that they can successfully carry out their "fleecings" of victims: in the past and the future!
Batman and Robin head west to see if they can stem the tide of cattle rustling, which has been caused by war-time rationing, and is the source of black market beef.
Alfred is in love, and to impress the fair maid he has designs on, he poses as the Batman, unaware that his "girl" is actually the Catwoman in disguise!
Batman and Robin must stop the Joker's mad schemes, as he commits several "up-side down crimes" that leave the Caped Crusaders literally standing on their heads.

Bruce Wayne is sent back to the time of the ancient Romans and runs afoul of a high official as Batman, so Robin must also make the journey back to help the Caped Crusader get out of the jam he is in.
Batman's attempt to set a trap to catch the Penguin and the Joker backfires and the two criminals form a partnership to commit crimes and outwit the Caped Crusaders.
The Cavalier returns in disguise to acquire a new mob that he plans to use to rob the city blind, but the theft of a whale undoes his plans.

Batman and Robin are puzzled when the Penguin begins stealing objects from people off the street, such as a handkerchief and a feather, unaware that he is attempting to train a young man in the fine art of crime.
When several wealthy playboys are taken in by a quick-rich scheme hatched by the Joker, Batman decides to visit the Crime Clown's layout that he called Shadow City.
Adam Frank has a fetish about being "the first" in everything he does, and when things don't work out to his advantage, he decides to turn to crime.

No matter what jobs the Penguin plans and tries to carry out, Batman and Robin are always there to stop him, but, in the end, it's one of the Penguin's own umbrellas that sends him back to the big house!

Punch and Judy are using a carnival to bilk residents of Gotham City and the Caped Crusaders see to it that the grafters working the concessions and games are removed from the grounds. However, Punch and Judy decide to strike back by having Batman and Robin join the carnival to put on a death-defying aerial stunt...and then proceed to kill them "by accident".
A series of college fraternity initiation rites are used by the Crime Clown to further enhance his own wealth, using Robin himself to carry them out.
Mobsters decide to use the Penguin as a ruse for Batman and Robin to follow while they commit crimes.

Racer Marty Steele is banned from racing when doctors discover he has a bad heart. But he has plans to compete anyway under another name, whilst his erstwhile opponent is a blind scientist. The prize for the winner is $250,000, a sum that Roy Damon hopes to take home in order to allow others who are blind to build new and better lives for themselves.

Catwoman arrives at the state women's prison and uses her catseye on her guard to make her escape. However, when she returns to her digs and attempts to put her gang back together, most want no part of her since Batman always defeats her. So the Catwoman decides on a daring plan: to prove to her boys she has the nine lives of a cat and cannot be killed!

The Penguin opens a new restaurant in town, but queerly asks guests to hand-write their orders and sign them, then he does everything possible to get himself arrested. Batman finally figures out that, once inside the jail, the Penguin can use homing pigeons to ferret out dozens of forged checks using the signatures he got in his restaurant!
Dr. King tries out his new radiotherapy machine on patient Jerry Marshall, and, while it is successful, its ray negatively affects a hospital worker, Lou Darrell, but not for the better.
The Joker becomes passionate about gambling, but ordinary stakes won't satisfy him. The stakes with death to the loser involves Batman and Robin.
Ritchie ditches school to go swimming.
The Joker escapes from prison and plans a new series of crimes based on greeting cards.
Catwoman escapes from prison and starts a high fashion magazine, where she features luxury items like minks and jewelry that she then steals for herself.
Believing that basing his past crimes on birds is what got him caught, Penguin escapes from prison and plans a new series of crimes that are not related to birds.
A gang robs a bank and hides the money before being captured, and they want the prison doctor to help fake their deaths so they can escape and recover the money.

While doing a series on law enforcement, Vicki Vale accompanies Batman and Robin as they encounter an ex-con being pursued by a racketeer for the location of hidden money, leading to Batman, Robin, and Vicki being captured by the crooks.
When Penguin discovers a talking penguin, he decides to retire from crime and go into show business to make money with his new star.

Bruce Wayne apparently drowns and Alfred is arrested for his murder, but it is all part of a plot to catch the Thinker, who is using a giant electronic brain to try to uncover Batman's secret identity.

Determined to prove himself as the greatest master of comedy ever, the Joker launches a series of crimes stealing seemingly worthless items, while Batman and Robin try to uncover a pattern to the crimes.
Batman and Robin track a thief who steals rare collectibles, whom they learn is a member of a club of collectors that Bruce Wayne belongs to.
The Joker organizes a syndicate of Jokers so that there can be a Joker in each of the 48 states.
The sickly Presidente of a Latin American nation implores the Caped Crusaders to come to his nation and train a Batman to keep law and order in his country.
Bruce Wayne's moral character is questioned when he is framed for acts he did not commit and stands trial to determine if he is a fit guardian for Dick Grayson.
The Penguin launches a series of crimes based the official state bird of the victims' native state.
A new crime-fighter, Deadshot, uses his uncanny aim to fight criminals, and plans to replace Batman as Gotham City's protector.
A new museum showcasing the different eras of history becomes a hide-out for criminals.
When criminals steal the Batplane to use in crimes, Batman and Robin race to build a new Batplane to stop them.

While working with the mystery crime boss Mister X, Catwoman risks her life to save Batman and receives a blow to the head. Upon waking, Selina Kyle has no memory of her criminal life as Catwoman, and agrees to work with Batman and Robin to capture Mister X.
Inspired by the many special costumes that Batman has worn in the past, the Joker launches a crime spree where he dresses in costumes of famous fictional comedy characters.

Gregory Bota is a collector of photos of crimes being committed, which he plans to use to blackmail crime bosses to take over their gangs. When Batman foils his plans, he vows to publish a photo of the death of Batman and Robin.

After Robin is sidelined with a broken leg, he fears that he is being replaced when Batman recruits a character called Wingman to be his partner. In reality, Batman is training Wingman to be a European version of Batman.
Joker is ridiculed when one of his crimes is foiled by his own mistake, so he decides to launch a crime spree based on famous mistakes, or "boners", in history.

When Batman is asked to donate one of his special ropes to a Gotham Historical Society exhibit, Commissioner Gordon, Robin, and Alfred all make guesses as to which rope he will donate.  But all are surprised by the rope that he actually donates.

Batman and Robin track a gang of thieves who steal from Atom Caves, where the wealthy store their valuables in bomb-proof caves beneath their property.  Unfortunately, the thieves discover the Bat-Cave located beneath Wayne Manor.

When Bruce Wayne suddenly becomes the owner of a movie studio, he finances the studios next production, a movie about Batman and Robin.  When the mob threatens the studio, no actors are willing play the lead roles, resulting in Bruce and Dick pretending to be actors playing Batman and Robin.
An inventor builds a robot to become a police officer, and the robot is so successful that Batman finds that he may no longer be needed.
Scar Brink creates a prison where he locks up members of law enforcement, and his prize prisoners are Batman and Robin.

After capturing the feared Sinister Eight, Commissioner Gordon asks the Dynamic Duo to deliver the crooks by radio-controlled ship to their prison at Satan's Island. The ship is torpedoed and sunk during a storm at sea by the Sinister Eight's minions, and all are washed ashore on an island, where Batman and Robin have to avoid capture by the villains before they can capture them.

Batman goes undercover to find the head of a criminal organization that rents out guns to other criminals to commit crimes and then disposes of the weapons afterward so they can't be used as evidence.

When the Joker commits seemingly crazy crimes he is sentenced to an insane asylum.  Batman realizes it is a ruse to get close to a patient who knows where a fortune is buried, so Batman goes undercover as a patient in the asylum to expose the Joker.
Batman and Robin pursue the criminal Jenko brothers to Outlaw Town, a western town where all of the residents are criminals and who plan to ambush Batman and Robin.
When members of the Danger Club are threatened, then violently are elminated one by one, Batman decides to join the club himself to try to track down the killer.
A scientist invents a machine that can predict crimes, which Batman and Robin hope will help them capture crime boss Mr. Blank, but the machine predicts that Mr. Blank will murder Batman.
The Batman learns that the new criminal called The Stranger is really a Martian, and, with the help of a lawman from Mars, tracks him down.
When the Shah of a foreign nation wants Vicki as his wife, she gets out of it (or so she thinks) by announcing that she is secretly engaged to Batman!

The Joker forms a movie production company and films his crimes as instructional films for the underworld.  Soon, Joker raises the stakes and starts filming a movie to show the underworld how to handle Batman and Robin by continually making the Dynamic Duo look silly with his pranks.

When the reformed Harvey Dent tries to prevent a robbery, he is caught in an explosion and reverts to Two-Face. He embarks on a new crime spree, and Batman and Robin deduce that Two-Face is going after people who commonly show two faces to the world. At a ceremony making Bruce Wayne honorary chief of a local tribe, Batman and Robin are trapped by Two-Face and strapped to a giant coin. Two-Face flips the coin over a bed of spikes, and though the gimmick is rigged to land face down, the dynamic duo manages to create a magnetic field and flip the coin so that they land safely.

Batman and Robin are rendered unconscious by a sting from a strange winged man, only to awake in a weird city inhabited by winged men, who want to operate on Batman to give him wings in order to track down desperate felons.
When Batman crashes in the Batplane in a remote mountainous area, crooks learn of it and hire an ex-con and Bruce Wayne look-alike to pose as Batman while they loot Gotham City.
The Dynamic Duo trail a gang of sugar thieves into a secluded jungle. A freak accident gives Batman an hallucination that the thieves are actually drones working for a race of giant bees!
During a tussle with the Joker, the pair step under and are bathed in "epsilon rays," which have the effect of transferring the personality on one person to that of the other.

After volunteering to become divers to remove explosives underwater at great depths, the Dynamic Duo are unable to properly rise to the surface slowly enough to prevent the bends. So they turn an ordinary submarine into a Bat-Marine and fight the criminal element under Slant Stacy successfully until the master criminal finds a way to get Batman out of the water, hoping he will die from the bends.

Batman is surprised and honored that a TV station is presenting his life story and recounting some of his greatest feats...until the Joker decides to break out of prison and do his own "honoring" of the Caped Crusader!
The Batman and Robin board a cruise ship at sea, the Vardonic, in order to track down an accomplish of a gang operating in Gotham City. The list of suspects includes four "Batmen"!
The Caped Crusaders are sent back in time by Carter Nichols to clear the name of Commissioner Gordon, who has been disgraced by reports that his great-grandfather led a group of bandits.

Dr. Peter Driscoll suffers from amnesia and cannot remember where he dropped a parcel with deadly microbes. Batman and Robin hopes to jog his memory by confronting him with three prisoners who served as his test subjects during the microbe research. But finding these men proves to be no easy matter: the first one stands accused of murder, the second one has gone legit and the third one is on the run.

An explorer from the famed "Explorer's Club" sets out to find an ancient lost city of the Incas, but refuses to share his secret with other members and eventually disappears. Batman is called in by the other Club members to track down their fellow member and find this lost city, not realizing one of the member wishes to loot the city.

Swamped by fan mail, Batman hires a secretary to handle all of it, who, unwittingly, causes the volume of mail to increase, thus hampering the Caped Crusader's war on crime. A threat from a forger, who has obtained an example of Batman's signature and who attempts to uncover Batman's true identity from it, has to be stopped in his tracks.

Batman and Robin are informed of the loss of valuable microfilm atop Mount K-4, which reveals the names of many members of an international crime cartel. Their job: recover it before the criminals do!

Unable to get the evidence he needs to convict hoodlum Marstin, Batman devises a plan to make sure that Marstin and his gang see the famed but dreaded bat symbol each time they try to commit a crime...a plan which eventually allows the Caped Crusaders to nab the felon.
Famed replica artifacts from various movie sets, located in a field not far from Hollywood, serve as the stage as a hideout for escaped convict Shag Darnell and his thugs.

A visiting royal dignitary visiting Gotham City gets an unexpected role he never expected: to play the role of Batman while the real Caped Crusader looks for a wanted felon. Unfortunately for Batman, the King doesn't want to give up that role once he gets it!
When Batman appears as an announcer on a TV show, the Joker decides to use announcers as part of his next crime spree.

Crooks steal a secret weapon created by author Jules Verne, so the Caped Crusaders travel back in time, bring Verne back to the present, and have him design a counter weapon that will nullify his deadly weapon.
Batman must stop the Fowl Felon's latest crime spree, which is based on the type of birds hatched from eggs.
When the city of Plainville decides to change its name to Batmantown in order to attract residents, Batman figures that it will draw the criminal element instead.
Gotham City is shocked to see Robin drive up to Police HQ one day in a Robinmobile, but he refuses to comment on the disappearance of his long-time partner in crime-fighting.

A wealthy man leaves money to Gotham to build a downtown HQ for Batman, but the Caped Crusader is surprised when the city builds as House of Batman for him. But he is more surprised when he discovers that a noted thief is using this building as his HQ.

While making a TV appearance, Bruce accidentally scrapes his chin. Realizing that the mark may lead people to conclude Batman is Bruce Wayne, the Caped Crusader stages a series of blunders that seek to cover up this fact.

Batman is seeking to capture John Varden, but the wily criminal eludes him. Meanwhile, an out-of-town detective named Crane enters the picture, accidentally discovering Batman's true identity, a fact well publicized by the media.

Batwoman believes that an amnesiac man she finds is really Batman and that she should re-train him in crime-fighting methods. Since Batman is injured and must stay out of action, he and Robin go along with her mistake, but the man is really the leader of a gang of crooks.

Criminal Jim Varrel watches a TV show on which Batman appears to personally thank ordinary citizens who have helped him put crooks behind bars, hoping to discover the identity of the person who betrayed him.
Danny Benson, a boy without a father, often talked to the Batman statue in the park. One day, he tells the statue about a gang of crooks and eventually he assists in the round-up of the criminals.
Batman appears on a TV game show to verify answers of a contestant, who dies after deducing the Caped Crusader's true identity.
Batman turns the table on a crook who has successfully stolen several of the Caped Crusader's prized trophies.

The attempted theft of a valuable flower ties in with a theory that the Batman has about the Joker being involved in a series of crimes, and discovers that the Crime Clown is selling plans for crimes to other criminals.

Batman and Robin are invited to become members of the famed Safari Club is quickly followed by the murder of one of the members, and the Dynamic Duo soon find themselves on a "safari" to ferret out the killer...before he kills them!
A small time criminal moves to Gotham and initiates a series of crimes, dressed as the bizarre Signalman. But Batman solves the clues to Signalman's crimes and nabs him.

Batman discovers that False Face has impersonated a wealthy uranium tycoon named P.S. Smithington, and, as Smithington, he has robbed a local Gotham City jewelry store, framing the true Smithington for the crime. Batman manages to rescue the actual Smithington, but is unable to recover the stolen jewels.
The Caped Crusaders and Professor race one another to Mechanical City to retrieve a stolen secret formula on microfilm.

Batman is given a clue to the whereabouts of stolen gems from a dying criminal, who warns the Caped Crusader that some of his henchmen are also seeking the loot. What he doesn't tell Batman is that the gems are booby-trapped!
The trail of the infamous Gimmick Gang leads the Caped Crusaders into Legend City, where, once a year, its residents dress up like legendary characters of old and have a celebration.
Batman rescues the head of the citizen's committee from the Red Gloves Gang, but later learns that he is the head of the gang, and must rescue him from them as well.
The Caped Crusaders have the task of saving four escaped felons from the radiation they have become contaminated with before they perish or infect others.

The "Woman of the Year" contest has two finalists: Vicki and Batwoman, and the judges decide to give both ladies a chance to prove their abilities before they select a winner...a winner who gets a date with the Batman!
Batman uses a clever plan involving a jinx on a Bat-Ring, which crooks get the Caped Crusader to wear, hoping it will bring him bad luck. Instead, it allows him to capture their leader.

As Bruce and Dick head for the Bat-Cave to change to their other identities, they discover the dead body of a man known for selling secrets to the underworld. Batman and Robin therefore must discover if this man sold the secret location of the Bat-Cave to underworld thugs.

While chasing a modern-day pirate, Blackjack, Batman and Robin are marooned in the Sargasso Sea. There they discover others who have been trapped for centuries by the seaweed and its strange age-defying gas, and with the help of these men they destroy Blackjack's weapons and escape in a repaired Batplane.
While vacationing in Florida, Batman and Robin save the life of a Seminole Indian who has discovered a cache of valuable artifacts once belonging to a famed explorer that a group of thugs are after.
Batman is subjected to an experimental light that renders him invisible. However, smuggler Smiley Gober finds a way to make the Caped Crusader visible: by throwing flour on him.
After Ace is brought to permanently live at Wayne Manor by John Wilker, Bat-Hound goes into action with Batwoman to save the Caped Crusaders trapped in a cave-in.
Batman is called to Alaska to recover 49 diamonds stolen from a rich tycoon.
Accidentally gaining super powers from a machine in the Bat-Cave, Alfred wants to use his powers to aid the Dynamic Duo as the Eagle, but he only hinders, not helps, them against the Joker.
Batman and Robin spot an alien being in need of help, and by doing so, get captured and transported to a strange planet.

While Batman and Robin are tracking a criminal called the Spinner, Batwoman is checking out a mystic, whom she believes is running a scam operation. The crime fighters paths cross when Batwoman checks out a lead to the Spinner that the mystic drops.
Gotham City prepares a number of fund-raising events to celebrate the anniversary of Batman's first case. At every event, however, criminals manage to make off with the proceeds.
Wounded and suffering from amnesia, Bat-Hound befriends a hermit and blind man, but hates the sight of anyone in a mask...including Batman himself!
An actor suffering amnesia believes that he is a Martian and at war with the world, When three criminals discover this, they trick the actor into helping them.
The Caped Crusaders must battle an ingenious criminal who uses kites to commit his crimes!
The Caped Crusaders, in South America to provide assistance to a leader, encounter a strange rainbow-colored creature that has emerged from a volcano.
The Dynamic Duo break up a gambling ring headed by "Wheels" Foster, but he manages to escape and threatens to kill the Caped Crusaders with a giant roulette wheel and its giant steel ball.
To have "some fun," Bat-Mite creates a series of imaginary villains for the Batman to overcome.
Robin informs Batman that he is quitting the team to join up with a new crime fighter on the scene, Mr. Marvel, although Batman doesn't suspect the real reason why.

Batman battles a renegade scientist using a Batman robot, which is damaged during the battle. Soon after, the mysterious Kadar appears on the scene, a mystic who knows Batman's every thought and plan.
The Signalman tries to get the drop on Batman by becoming a Green Arrow clone, thanks to training provided to him by Green Arrow's foe, Bulls-Eye.
The Joker appears to die during a prison escape, but his ghostly figure survives to commit crimes and taunt Batman from beyond the grave.
A strange clock arrives at Police HQ, which gives clues to up-coming crimes. Batman is able to correctly decipher the third clue in order to round up the Clockmaster.
Having received a guardian robot from an alien he once befriended, Batman discovers the creature will not allow the Caped Crusader to put his life on the line in fighting crooks.
After the Caped Crusaders round up a gang of jewel thieves, Robin fantasizes how the adventure would be retold in the future as a mythological tale involving giants and flying creatures.
Two aliens come to Earth to fight a duel over a girl, and they don't care who gets in the way.
The Dynamic Duo trace a smuggling ring to Hawaii and travel there to confront them in order to locate the ring leader.

When the Dynamic Duo save the life of a magician, he gives the Caped Crusaders certain powers, not realizing that when Batman and Robin use these powers, Bat-Mite is actually responsible for their amazing abilities.
A gang of crooks enters Gotham and begins using strange seeds to grow alien plants in order to commit crimes.
Alien bandits create electrical twins of Batman and Robin to fend them off when the Caped Crusaders attempt to enter a strange city that appears out of nowhere.
Angered because of poor reviews of his music concerts, Payne Cardine turns to crime. Batman then uses a music expert to decipher the clues left behind by Cardine as the Maestro of Crime.
The Caped Crusader goes undercover to learn about a fantastic underworld army being formed to overtake the country.
The Caped Crusaders' secret identities are compromised, forcing them to adopt entirely new identities in order to continue their war on crime.
The Caped Crusaders and Bat-Hound track a renegade scientist to Switzerland, who is in the process of handing over a portion of an explosive formula to a European criminal.
A strange alien arrives on Earth and begins stealing silver. When our four heroes begin pursuing him, they are all transported to different dimensions.

As Dick begins reading Alfred's latest imaginary tale of Batman II and Robin II, he is called upon by the Caped Crusader to battle Big Al and his men, with all involved in circumstances strangely resembling Alfred's story.

A rare chemical explosion psychically links Batman with Jo-Jo Gagan, and when the underworld finds out about this, they turn on Gagan and attempt to kill him, believing that the Caped Crusader will perish as well.

After Batman announces that he is going away on a secret government mission, a pint-sized crime fighter by the name of Ant-Man pops up to help him out, but the Boy Wonder wrongly guesses that it is Batman in disguise.

After receiving a tip on a crime from reporter Hal Lake, Batman goes undercover and discovers that Lake is using an underworld alias in order to gather information, is mentally unbalanced, and a criminal called the Jackal.

Bat-Mite shows up again to have some fun and decides to give Ace some super powers, which he uses to aid the Caped Crusaders. However, when Ace chases crooks into a cave, the mine fumes cause havoc with the dog's super powers, and he turns on the Dynamic Duo.

After escaping from prison, Matt Hagen finds a way to synthesize the liquid that turns him into Clayface, and once more takes up crime. The Joker, meanwhile, objects to Clayface getting all the headlines, so he starts a feud with Clayface.
The Dynamic Duo track Ed Kiley to Madcap Island, home to numerous wealthy eccentrics, and discovers him murdered.
The Mad Hatter pulls a string of robberies based on the professions of the jurors that sentenced him on his last arrest.

A mad scientist has invented a ray which turns men into animal creatures, who steal for him. When he turns the ray on Batman, turning the Caped Crusader into a creature, it's all Robin, Batwoman and Bat-Hound can do to stop him.

Betty returns to Gotham City and adopts the guise of Batwoman II. With Batman and Robin II both out of town, the original Batman must go into action and gets captured in the process. When Batwoman II saves him, she learns his secret identity in the process.
Batman discovers a plot to waylay a group of folk singers in order to perpetrate the theft of a pearl from a museum, and eventually nabs the villain after foiling a trap set for the criminal.

When it is discovered that he is a mutant, Governor Warner agrees to step down from office and undergo an experiment that will allow him to quickly evolve. He does, and he becomes an entirely new species with contempt for the human race.
Two crooks overhear Batman creating a supposedly inescapable trap and make plans to lure Batman into such a trap.
A dying Interpol man informs Batman that a criminal named Karabi has plans to instigate a nuclear war.
Batman helps cure a circus strong man of his wild mood swings by deducing that radio music tends to cause aggressive behavior in him.
The Penguin uses an umbrella barrage to trick Batman into planning his next crime for him.

Roy Reynolds, wanting to not make the same mistakes of other criminals, decides to uses a series of getaway gimmicks on the Caped Crusader to effect the escape of he and his men...and succeeds, until Batman baits a trap of his own.

The Riddler is released from prison and informs the Dynamic Duo that he has turned from crime, and, as proof, leads them to the hideout of the Molehill Mob. But when the former felon begins deluging them with riddles, the Caped Crusaders aren't sure he really has reformed.

An ancient legend involving suits of armor coming to life and destroying some opals in a museum appears to come to pass, and challenges the wits of the Caped Crusaders to discover the facts behind this legend.

While the Caped Crusaders are raiding the hideout of Mr. Incognito, a photographer takes pictures of the action with a special x-ray film, revealing the criminal's identity. The man offers to provide the identity to the Police for a million dollars while also offering the secret identities of the Dynamic Duo to the underworld for a price.
Hunter breaks the Getaway Genius out of jail in order to provide a getaway gimmick, all the while planning a trap for the Batman.

Swearing revenge on the Caped Crusaders, Eddie Repp invents a ghost imaging device and creates such images of the Dynamic Duo, who begin to fight crime in Gotham more effectively than the real heroes they resemble.
The Penguin is released from prison on parole, providing he gives up anything having to do with birds. So he takes up an umbrella business...with the same criminal results!
Batman concocts a scheme against numbers racketeer Ed Garvey to prove conclusively that the crook planned and carried out the Kimber Gem job.

When two experimental missiles disappear after being launched, the Caped Crusaders follow the path of the third missile and discover that it has been intercepted by a strange beam, set in motion by jet-propelled crooks!

An actor announces on TV that he has solved a murder case and will announce who the killer is the next day. When the actor confesses to Bruce Wayne that this was an act to lure the real killer out into the open, the Caped Crusader poses as the actor to protect the man's life.

Batman stops a crook in a skeleton costume who boasts that he will escape justice. On the way from the courtroom, the man falls over and apparently dies, a fact that haunts the Batman, especially when he thinks of the man's boast. When Death-Man reappears, the Caped Crusaders get him again, only to have him die a second time, only to be resurrected again. Batman wonders: will the third time be the "lucky" charm that ends this menace?
While Bruce and Dick are attending an art show, a woman shows up, claiming to be the greatest criminal of those currently residing in Gotham.
Batman and Robin must face the danger created by a man who can control the elements.

Missing the imprisoned Poison Ivy, the Caped Crusader receives a gift from her and she promises to repent. Batman visits her, but he is placed under her spell, and she uses him to make good her escape.
The Caped Crusaders mysteriously disappear for two weeks, and when they return, they have no memory of where they have been.
The Joker returns to haunt the Caped Crusaders, this time with a new member added to his gang: Gaggy, who makes the Joker laugh, which then inspires the Clown Prince of Crime with new crime ideas.

The sudden appearance of a new criminal basing his crime on time jogs Batman's memory into remembering that this criminal was his very first case after his parents were killed, and if the Clock has his way, the current case against him will be the Caped Crusader's last!
Commissioner Gordon gets Batman to investigate a series of crimes in which all of the clues have been erased, and the Caped Crusader goes undercover to do so.

While entertaining some children in the park, Dick happens to notice the Scarecrow retrieving buried loot from a past robbery. He calls in Batman and together they battle their old foe until they are blinded by Scarecrow's fear gas.

Penguin attempts to fool the Caped Crusaders into believing that his new tricks are based on futuristic technology. When this fails and his gang is captured the Fowl villain begins using robotic umbrellas against the Dynamic Duo.

When Ira Radon absorbs so much radiation that he is forced to give up his life of crime, he decides to get revenge by dousing Batman's equipment with deadly radiation, forcing the Caped Crimefighter to give up his career.

The Caped Crusaders accidentally come across a crime committed by the Fearsome Foursome and succeed in capturing a member of that gang. Batman then disguises himself as that crook in order to infiltrate the gang and nab the leader...or so he thinks.

When Bruce and Dick visit the Gotham City museum, they note an image of a Viking that looks like Bruce Wayne who is labeled a coward, so they have Professor Nichols send them back in time so that they can discover the truth.
By chance, a reformed Mark Desmond sees a Batman display at a local department store and reverts back to his Blockbuster persona, which goes out to destroy anything related to the Caped Crusader.

Creegan steals some jewels from the laboratory of a scientist, who has treated the gems with radition. During a battle with the Caped Crusaders, Creegan is transformed into a skeletal figure possessing a deadly electrical touch.
The Dynamic Duo team up with a person they believe to be a psychic detective, but soon learn that he is an impostor, and his men are holding the real Dubrov prisoner.
Catwoman decides to reform and become a crime fighter like Batman in order to get him to somehow propose to her. When he doesn't, she gives him an ultimatum: to marry her or she returns to crime!

While investigating criminal activity at a transport company, Batman recognizes the owner, Joe Chill, as the man who killed Thomas and Martha Wayne years before. Batman tries to find evidence of Chill's illegal operations, but when he fails, he decides to reveal his identity to Chill and tells him that will be watching him and will catch him eventually. In a panic, Chill flees to his gang, but when they find out Chill is responsible for Batman's existence they shoot him, and only after do they realize that they should have asked Chill for Batman's real name.

After escaping from the clutches of the Dynamic Duo, Rembrandt Dickens decides to pursue the life of a comic book artist, detailing the crimes he has committed. But when his gang is released from prison, Dickens gives each of them poison rings, one of which scratches the Batman, and he will die, unless he finds the latest copy of Batman Comics, which contains a clue to Dickens' whereabouts and antidote for the poison.

When the Scarecrow perfects a fear pill and uses it on the Caped Crusaders, the duo are unable to continue their war on crime until Alfred enters the picture. Then the Caped Crusaders head out and capture several of their foes, each one having a clue on their persons which lead them to the Scarecrow.

A west coast crime syndicate moves into Gotham City with the intent to eliminate Batman any way they can, while seven of the Caped Crusader's foes join forces to stop them, fearing that they might be next on the syndicate's list.
A rash of psychic robberies, in which objects appear to move with the power of mind over matter, puzzle the Caped Crusaders, but not Alfred.

An escaped convict on the run accidentally discovers the entrance to the Batcave and learns the secret identities of Batman and Robin. He attacks the Dynamic Duo using their own weapons and trophies against them.

An unscrupulous criminal named the Schemer kills an innocent blind man and plants evidence on him to lead Commissioner Gordon to believe that he is the Batman! When the real Batman shows up on the scene, the Police arrest him, believing that he is a phony.

The Police, believing that the Batman is dead, arrest and take in the Batman whom they believe is an imposter, while the real Batman, disguised as a blind man, aids Robin to prevent an armored car robbery. Robin is captured by the Schemer in the process but Batman outwits the Schemer in his attempt to down a plane loaded with gold.

After capturing a gang of crooks from a crime planned by the Planner, the villain engages in a duel of wits with the Caped Crusader to make him look bad. Batman turns the tables on the crook and he is sent to prison to die in the electric chair: in a Batman uniform!

A small nuclear device is stolen and is being used to threaten Gotham City, so Batman enlists the aid of a criminal named Brill to identify the blackmailer...but first, the Caped Crusaders must survive some death traps arranged by Brill and his men.
Queen Bee and Eclipso start a crime wave in Gotham City, and frame Batman for the theft of a jewel from the city museum.
After his parents are murdered by Boss Zucco's men, Dick Grayson is taken in by Bruce Wayne who trains him as Robin and together they bring Boss Zucco to justice.
Breakup of Batman & Robin team. Dick Grayson goes to college. Bruce and Alfred move from Wayne Manor to the Wayne Foundation.

A stolen sonic weapon causes the Dynamic Duo to forget everything about their pasts, but their detective skills remain intact and help them to recall their true identities and to recover the weapon before it can be used again.
Batman stops an airplane hijacking and gets a senator to Washington DC in time for a critical vote on an anti-crime bill.
Marla Manning comes to Bruce Wayne for help finding the killer of Tom Sloane.
Batman discovers the source of the pollution that is turning ordinary animals into killers.
When Bruce and Dick visit London's Scotland Yard, they are shocked to see a frame that once held a picture of Batman and Robin empty, and seek to find out why this has happened.
A Jazz musician is beaten to death in New Orleans and Batman comes to find his killer.

Professor "Buck" Stuart is running for congress against incumbent Forte on a platform of cleaning up the polluted river that Forte has allowed ICM to dump their chemicals into.  When Stuart's campaign headquarters are burned to the ground, Robin investigates.
When Batman crashes in the Batplane in a remote mountainous area, crooks learn of it and hire an ex-con and Bruce Wayne look-alike to pose as Batman while they loot Gotham City.
Robin discovers the truth behind a fake photo of candidate Stuart and who burned down his campaign headquarters.
Robin discovers who bombed the ROTC building on Hudson University.
When Dick Grayson and Terri Bergstrom's apartments are burglarized, Robin tracks down the criminals.
Ra's Al Ghul discovers Batman's secret identity.
Bruce Wayne becomes a member of the strange "Death Cheaters Club," but a wanted criminal, who fits the qualifications for membership, is denied the same...and vows vengeance against all the members!
When a cop is shot, Robin travels to a commune to find the shooter.
Ra's Al Ghul forces Batman to track down Striss, who has stolen a secret formula from Ra's.  Striss does not know the deadly secret of the chemical formula.
Robin and the commune fight a wildfire and convince the surrounding neighbors to help them before the fire gets out of control.
Dick Grayson and his college friends travel to the Halloween celebration in Rutland Vermont.  Robin and Batman get caught between two sides, both looking for revenge against an ex-Nazi officer.
Batman disguises himself as the crook Drexel to infiltrate the Crime Academy.
On Christmas Eve, Batman tracks down a thug who wants revenge on his former boss.
Batman and Talia track down the killer of Mason Sterling and Batman discovers who removed Sterling's brain.
Howard MacGuffin, a young diplomat, is forced to steal government secrets when Colonel Sulphur kidnaps his wife.
Batman begins his war against Ra's Al Ghul by faking Bruce Wayne's death and recruiting some allies.
Batman engages in mortal combat with Lo Ling. Batman tracks Ra's Al Ghul to Switzerland, only to find he is dead. Ra's Al Ghul is revived by a Lazarus Pit.
Batman tracks Ra's Al Ghul to the desert and is forced to fight him in a duel.
Batman stops a crooked political group for framing another political group for the murder of Bruce Wayne.
Someone is demonstrating ways to "kill" Robin by using dummies to torture Batman.  Batman must track them down and rescue the real Robin.

Dick Grayson and Diane Lewis are giving some local youths a tour of a castle that is supposedly haunted.  When Diana and some of the children disappear, Dick changes to Robin and discovers the secret behind the "ghosts" in the castle.
Batman tracks down the boss behind a gun-smuggling operation.
Robin tracks down some stolen paintings, one of which is of his parents doing their circus act.
Famous actor Davy King enrolls in Hudson University to get his college degree.  Mysterious accidents happen around him until Robin is able to figure out who is behind them.
The recent rash of unsolved robberies in Gotham City spurs Man-Bat to come out of retirement.

The discovery of an old Batman-type costume in Bruce Wayne's attic re-opens the Wayne murder case, and helps him realize that Joey Chill had only been hired to kill his parents...and the real man responsible was still alive and free.
When Bruce discovers that Dick has left Hudson University to investigate some mystery at the Tip-Top Circus, Batman decides to join the Teen Wonder to investigate a murder at the circus.
When a young King is kidnapped by the Penguin, it takes the efforts of Batman, Robin and Talia to free him from the madman's clutches.
Two-Face returns, having devised a plan to extort $2 billion from the citizens of the U.S. If the government refuses to pay, the criminal plans to destroy the government...forever!
Batman goes on the trail of a convicted felon from the past, believing that he has stolen a valuable tiara. But he's wrong and discovers that only "The Shadow Knows" who actually is responsible.

The Joker escapes from prison and drugs Batman with a laughing virus that will cause him to laugh himself to death in three days, then the Joker kills one of the only men in the world who could prepare an antidote.

A group of crooks, led by Brainy Bulow, are down on their luck and worried that they can't make an honest dollar. Then they notice a "Wanted" poster, and decide to go into an honest business for once: rounding up wanted felons and cashing in on their rewards!
Someone has sent hypnotic letters to several people, including Bruce Wayne, and booby trapped some of their possessions so they will end up killing each other.
When the daredevil Al "Devil" Dayre is kidnapped, Batman must find him and discover who is behind the kidnapping and ransom.

At the pier, a desert tribesman sets off a camel stampede, in which "oil baron" Fredrick Goforth is trampled. Later, at the Sports Arena, Oliver Hopkins, one of Goforth's business partners, is shot by a burnoose-clad gunman. On the Arena roof, Batman barely survives his encounter with the self-proclaimed "Sheikh". Injured, Batman reluctantly accepts Robin's help with the case. Robin makes a discovery at the morgue, while Batman fails to save the life of the last of the three business partners, but what he learns about the Sheikh enables him and Robin to wrap up the mystery, back at the Arena.
When people start dying, Batman puts the facts together but comes up with the wrong suspect.
The Underworld Olympics has begun.  The team from South America is up first but didn't plan on Batman interfering with their plans.

The Afro-Asian team gets their target in the Underworld Olympics.  They almost succeed but Batman stops them at the end.  Batman realizes that some kind of contest is going in in Gotham City between various groups of international criminals.
The Spook is using subliminal messages to try to get the Batman to kill.
Dr. Tzin-Tzin escapes from prison during the holiday season and plots to make the people of Gotham City forget about Christmas.

When word spreads throughout the underworld that Batman has been killed, several villains take credit for the deed. So the villain community sets up a trial to test the various claims, with Ra's al Ghul acting as judge and Two-Face acting as prosecutor. First up is the Catwoman. But Two-Face finds the technical error in Catwoman's story and she is dismissed.
It is the Riddler's turn to provide testimony in the murder of the Batman, but the prosecutor Two-Face finds the flaw in the Riddler's testimony, and he is also dismissed.
Lex Luthor's claim to have killed the Batman is refuted by surprise witness Superman, who convinces the jury that Luthor did not kill Batman, as he thought.

The Joker testifies to the circumstances whereby he killed Batman, but when Two-Face demands that the Joker produce the photographic evidence he claims to have, a recess is called. After Two-Face leaves the court, he removes his disguise, revealing the Batman beneath. Having identified the real murderer, Batman confronts the Joker and sends him back to Arkham. Later, Batman confers with Commissioner Gordon and discusses how it was really Batman-admirer Jerry Randall in a Batman costume that the Joker had killed and how the trial was a ruse to discover who was actually responsible.

When Danton, Art Saddows, and Kaye Daye each witness the same woman's body turn up at 3 different locations only to have it disappear after it is loaded into the ambulance but before it arrives at the morgue, the Mystery Analysts investigate the Magic Palace, a night club for magic-related acts.  They learn that the murdered woman was a magician's assistant, but who killed her?

Perry Travers dies during a botched robbery and his autopsy reveals his membership as a Wirehead in the mob of The Overlord. Batman takes to a disguise as Akeldama to smoke out The Overlord and a mole in the police department, and arrives just as Luke Brant kills The Overlord.

Batman investigates two mysteries: he must track down the Death's Head Group who has been setting off bombs through out Gotham, and investigate 6 businessmen who have gambled their fortunes away. He learns that all the businessmen had visited the Gotham Isle casino, so he investigates as Bruce Wayne.  But Bruce is affected by the device that caused the other businessmen to gamble recklessly, which puts Batman in danger when he goes after the bombers.
Batman tries to take down drug overlord Hanniball Hardwicke, but ends up having to protect him when the Black Spider returns with the intent to kill him.

The Joker plans his own birthday party and invites all of Gotham to watch the explosive celebration with some of Batman's closest allies. It is up to the Caped Crusader to find the event before the fireworks start.
Batman tries to help Catwoman, the prime suspect in the theft of the Egyptian Cat-God Exhibition, but finds himself trapped along with Catwoman by Cat-Man.
Batman investigates a man who, after being acquitted of murder, admits that he did actually kill the victim - twice!
Batman discovers that Two-Face is back, and that he has killed the man who killed Gilda's second husband in the hope to win her back.

Death row inmate Arch Sklyar promises a fortune in gold to anyone who is able to kill Batman before Arch is executed in 24 hours.  Meanwhile, Batman and Robin investigate Tim Fox, son of Lucius, who has fallen in with a bad crowd.

Batman faces a new villain, the Electrocutioner, who goes after criminals who have been freed on a technicality to mete out his own lethal brand of justice.  Meanwhile, Bruce becomes concerned over a competitor to Wayne Entrprises, and Dick's investigation of Wayne Enterprises reveals some disturbing findings.

With the arrival of Talia, Dick moves out of Wayne Manor.  Bruce learns that Caroline has been blackmailed by Gregorian Falstaff to reveal Wayne Enterprises secrets.  Batman confronts Falstaff and finds that Talia may be involved.  Meanwhile Dick seeks out Catwoman for help to investigate Talia.
Batman and Talia travel to Switzerland, China, and Hong Kong to track who hired Falstaff to sabotage Bruce Wayne's businesses.

Batman finds himself a prisoner on Infinity Island.  Robin, Catwoman, and King Faraday escape from Shanghai, but are captured and also imprisoned along with Batman.  Talia attempts a rescue, but is forced to join their mysterious adversary, who is revealed as Ra's Al Ghul.

To save the lives of his friends, Batman agrees to serve Ra's Al Ghul, but it is a ruse and soon Batman faces Ra's, who has been empowered by the Lazarus Pit, in a final battle.  Talia decides to betray her father and side with Batman.
Batman encounters a new threat, a living snowman with icy powers.
Batman investigates the death of several sports figures, and finds that it is the work of a new villain, The Sportsman.
Poison Ivy uses a hypnotic drug to influence Wayne Foundation board members, including Bruce Wayne, to sign over the assets of the Wayne Foundation to her.
Batman investigates when prominent citizens are killed by a human mole.

After reported sightings of ghosts at the Wayne Manor, Commissioner Gordon brings in Ghost Breaker Dr. Thirteen to search the manor, while Batman tries to prevent them from discovering the hidden Batcave underneath.

Batman rescues Dr. Thirteen from Man-Bat's attack in the Batcave, but Man-Bat escapes. After learning from Francine Langstrom that Kirk has changed after taking the wrong dosage of Man-Bat serum, Batman returns to the caves near Wayne Manor to try the help Kirk, who in his delirium believes that his daughter is dead and that Batman is responsible.

Batman faces a new villain Dagger, a blade-wielding extortionist. Meanwhile, Poison Ivy stakes her claim on the Wayne Foundation using the documents that she hypnotically induced Bruce and the other board members into signing that gives control of the company's assets to her.

On the eve of the mayoral election, Arthur Reeves threatens to reveal Batman's secret identity to swing the vote in his favor. Meanwhile, Batman stalks Ivy hoping to get her to reveal how she hypnotized the Wayne Foundation board into signing over the company's assets to her.

Doctor Death has spread a deadly allergen over Gotham, infecting many, including Dick Grayson. Batman and an ailing Robin must track down Doctor Death to find a cure in time. Meanwhile, newly sworn in mayor Hamilton Hill demands Gordon's resignation.

Two-Face hypnotizes his guards at Arkham and escapes. He puts an elaborate plan together with Margo, who he met in prison and captures Batman. At Mayor Hill's demand, Gordon resigns as police commissioner.

Bruce, Dick, and Alfred move back to Wayne Manor, where they are confronted by Francine Langstrom who demands that Bruce live up to his promise to find and rescue Kirk. Batman brings young Rebecca along as he searches the cave system near Wayne Manor to find Man-Bat, who still believes that his daughter is dead and that Batman is his enemy.

In Eternia, Zodac attempts to warn Prince Adam about a death he has foreseen. Skeletor searches the Dark Sea for the missing half of the Power Sword. On Earth, Superman follows three energy spheres underwater, where he is pulled into a vortex. Superman arrives in Eternia, and is faced with Skeletor, Beast-Man and Mer-Man. Superman gets one half of the Power Sword away from Skeletor, but Skeletor attacks with the remaining half. He-Man arrives and picks up the fallen half, hurling it at Skeletor. The power of the sword disintegrates Skeletor. He-Man dies but is revived by the sword's energies.
Batman tracks The Squid, a new villain who has taken over Gotham's underworld.
Batman tracks the killer of The Squid, Killer Croc, the newest villain to take control of Gotham's underworld.
As Batman tracks Killer Croc, Croc breaks into prison to kill rival gang boss Tony Falco. Meanwhile, Joe and Trina Todd decide to follow Croc's man who has been threatening the circus.
Jason dyes his hair and disguises himself as Robin to help fight the Joker.

Jason takes over as the new Robin with Dick's blessing, unaware that Crazy-Quilt is on the loose and out for revenge against Robin, not realizing there is a new Robin now.  Meanwhile in Canada, Alfred and Julia find that Julia is targeted for murder.
Tired of being looked upon as a joke, the Penguin decides to plan new crimes that will make everyone take him more seriously.
Batman searches for Night Slayer as Doctor Fang, recently released from prison, vows to settle the score with Batman.  Jason Todd spends some time with his adoptive mother, Nocturna.

Batman hunts down Night-Slayer who has been committing crimes all over Gotham City dressed as Batman.  Meanwhile, Jason Todd searches for evidence that his adoptive mother, Nocturna, has not given up her life of crime; James Gordon is welcomed back as Commissioner as the truth about Mayor Hill is uncovered.
Batman teams with Catwoman to stop a Syrian terrorist, Darkwolf, who has hijacked a plane at Gotham International Airport.
Sleep eludes both Bruce Wayne and Batman in this 24-hour tale.
Calendar Man has promised to kill Robin on the first day of spring.  After being forbidden to leave the batcave, Robin disobeys Batman and goes after Calendar Man himself.
Roman Sionis loses his family's company, Janus Cosmetics, and turns to a life of crime as Black Mask.
Bruce Wayne uses himself as bait by hosting a mascarade ball at Wayne Manor to lure Black Mask.
After trying to steal the same jade necklace, Captain Boomerang and Mirror Master face off to decide who is the greater villain.

Nocturna, Catwoman, and Night-Slayer all return in this issue as members of Black Mask's False Face Society are being killed off one-by-one.  Acting Mayor Skowcroft blames Catwoman for the murders as Robin and Bullock learn that Nocturna has moved into the observatory.

Catwoman tries to clear her name of the False Face Society murders by tracking down Nocturna and is injured while fighting Batman.  Nocturna uses the observatory to try to find out what is causing the red rain.
Nightslayer finally finds Nocturna, but now must also face Batman, Robin, and Catwoman.
Batman and Catwoman's night out is constantly interrupted by criminals. Harvey Bullock tries to convince Commissioner Gordon to arrest Catwoman for her previous crimes.
Batman travels to Europe to help the CIA and KGB bring down a rouge agent called the Dark Rider.
Batman teams up with a KGB agent to take down the terrorist known as the Dark Rider, who has smuggled plutonium into Gotham.
Batman and Catwoman team up to track down The Film Freak, a one-time actor turned theatrically-themed thief, while Robin teams up with Harvey Bullock to do the same.
Magpie shows up at a party showing the Wayne collection of jewels where G. Gordon Godfrey shows up. She escapes and Batman and Robin track her to a museum.

Bruce and Gordon both arrive in Gotham on missions that are sure to put their paths on a collision course. Gordon joins the GCPD which is rife with corruption and he is taught a savage lesson when he tries to buck this new system. Bruce tries out his years of training in a simple street brawl that does not go as planned. Wounded and searching for inspiration, Bruce finds it as a bat flies through the window.
Bruce dons his new guise as Batman and begins to clean up Gotham. When he starts to harass the corrupt officials of the city, the police are commanded to take him down.
The police have Batman cornered and are intent on taking him in and it will take all of his training and cunning to escape from their grasp.

Batman takes on the upper echelons of organized crime and becomes allies with Gordon.
The Gordons have a baby boy.

With his training complete, Jason prepares to go on his first patrol with Batman as Robin. When Two-Face strikes, Batman is concerned that Jason will find out that Two-Face killed his father and want revenge.
Batman and Robin try to stop Two-Face's latest crime spree, but Jason wants revenge after learning that Two-Face killed his father.

Batman learns that Gordon has been replaced by a Manhunter when the Commissioner attacks him, then escapes. Meanwhile, Robin disobeys orders by capturing the Scarecrow when he was only supposed to follow him. When the heroes reconnect, they follow Gordon to Arkham, where he plans to free the Floronic Man, one of the ten humans chosen for the Millennium event.
Felipe hides behind diplomatic immunity to terrorize Gloria. He falls to his death after being confronted by Robin.

Jason discovers that his "real" mother was really his step-mother, and his birth mother is still alive. Joker escapes from Arkham and Batman chases him to the Middle East where he runs across Jason looking for one of the women he thinks is his mom.

Jason meets his real mother, Sheila Haywood, but she turns out to be working for the Joker and allows her son to fall into his deadly hands inside a warehouse. Joker beats Robin with a crowbar and leaves him for dead as a badly beaten Robin attempts to save his mom and himself from the dynamite left behind by the Joker as he leaves them both to a horrible fate. Batman watches in horror as the warehouse containing Jason and Sheila blows up, too late to stop the Joker.
Death of Sheila Haywood. Burial of Sheila Haywood and Jason Todd. Joker becomes the Iranian Ambassador to the U.N.
Batman discovers that Two-Face is back in town and planning his demise.
Tim Drake reveals how he deduced Batman was Bruce Wayne.
Tim Drake dons the Robin costume and saves Batman and Nightwing from Two-Face.
The Penguin takes in Harold, a deformed genius, who builds a device that gives Penguin the ability to control birds, which he uses to cause the birds to attack various targets in Gotham.

Batman must find a way to stop Penguin and his control over birds, while Penguin plans to sell the bird control technology to the highest bidder.  Harold learns that Penguin has been using him and frees Sherry West and escapes.
The Joker returns with a crime spree of robbery and murder, but all is not as it seems.
Curtis Base continues his crime spree posing as the Joker, which draws the attention of the real Joker.

Batman is led through a labyrinthine urban maze by his old nemesis the Riddler, who seems to have changed into an abominable monster with one purpose: to drive Batman insane. As, in the present day, Batman takes on the Riddler's challenges, while in the past the story also explores the connection between Gotham City and the occult.
Tim mourns his mother and feels he is ready to be Robin, but Batman disagrees. Meanwhile, something is causing ordinary people to suddenly go on murderous rampages.

Vicki Vale is captured as she tracks down those responsible for causing ordinary people to go on sudden killing sprees. Batman attempts to rescue her. Meanwhile Tim has discovered the culprit, but is unable to reach Batman to let him know who he is up against.

With Batman and Vicki captured by the Scarecrow, Tim risks his potential future as Robin by disobeying Bruce's orders to go rescue them. After successfully rescuing Batman and defeating the Scarecrow, Batman presents to Tim a new Robin costume for him to wear.

When a girl goes missing a group of parents decide to take matters into their own hands.  Meanwhile, Commissioner Gordon reflects on missed opportunities in life as he prepares to welcome an old acquaintance.

While Commissioner Gordon and Sarah Essen re-kindle their romance on a Saturday night at the movies, Batman tracks a drug dealer, leading to a confrontation with a gunman and a young family coming from the movie theater, which triggers memories of the death of the Waynes.

Catwoman returns and is out to steal a priceless emerald cat from a museum exhibit. Joe Potato comes to Batman with a lead on a human trafficking ring. With Jim Gordon recovering from his heart attack in the hospital, Sarah Essen is on the trail of Catwoman.

While Batman and Joe Potato investigate the human trafficking ring, Vick Vale and Sarah Essen are both on the trail of Catwoman, who is out to steal a priceless emerald cat, unaware that it is bait in a trap to capture Catwoman for the trafficking ring.
When a businessman is killed and Indian artifacts are stolen, Batman's investigation leads him to San Francisco.
On the way from San Francisco to Las Vegas, Batman makes a stop in Death Valley to save Black Wolf from Two-Hearts' killers.
To save the lives of innocents, Black Wolf challenges Two-Hearts to a ritual combat against Batman.

On Tim's first night patrolling as Robin, he tries to come to the aide of a damsel in distress but his efforts backfire. Bruce makes an effort to help two underprivileged youths. Later a charity event becomes the setting for a bizarre drama.
Batman and Robin are chasing Willy the Sap and his gang when they hide in an amusement park.
Batman travels into the Idiot Zone to battle The Idiot but fails and The Idiot manifests in the real world.
Two wealthy men are kidnapped and tortured.  Batman must figure out how they are connected and track down the person responsible.
Bane frees the inmates of Arkham Asylum.
Bane breaks Batman's back.
Jean-Paul Valley becomes Batman.
Jean-Paul Valley starts altering the Batman costume.

Recovered from his injuries but not at full fighting strength, Bruce Wayne goes to Lady Shiva for training. He refuses to accept her insistence on killing opponents, so she frames him for the death of the Armless Master, knowing that his followers will seek Bruce out for revenge. Meanwhile, Jean-Paul as Batman is pursuing a gang of gunrunners but the pressure is getting to him and he believes that his father and Saint Dumas are communicating with him.

Jean-Paul is furious when Bruce demands his Batman identity back and the two men fight. Catwoman takes advantage of the battle and pursues Selkirk on her own. He tries to escape by helicopter but Jean-Paul's grappler malfunctions and both Batmen are dragged into the sky behind the copter.

The effects of Zero Hour causes two timelines to mingle, leading to Batman and Robin encountering a healthy Barbara Gordon as Batgirl, who is out to avenge the death of her father James Gordon, while the new police commissioner Harvey Dent has the Gotham PD hunting Batman and his team.
Bruce returns as Batman.
Jim Gordon is replaced as Commissioner by his wife Sarah.
Batman, Nightwing and Robin travel to the desert in Africa in search for clues to the Legacy virus.  Huntress covers for Batman in Gotham City.
With the sun extinguished and Gotham City in round-the-clock darkness, Man-Bat becomes increasingly violent as Batman struggles to cure him.
Batman and Robin track down the serial killer known as Faceless.
Batman and Special Agent Leary have to stop Banner from blowing up a government building.
Batman and Alfred fight a rat problem in the Bat-Cave.
Adrian Lupus, a delusional criminal who believes himself to be an artist, assaults a woman and flees from the lurking Batman.
Batman must stop a breakout at Arkham Asylum and also protect the lives of a reporter and his cameraman.
Batman continues his war on the Penguin's illegal operations.
James Gordon's fellow officers throw him a birthday party. It has an unhappy ending.

Using the "Matches" Malone cover, Batman shuts down Ventriloquist's gun running operation. Ventriloquist puts out a contract on "Matches." Oracle calls the cave looking for Batman, surprised to see him there since "Matches" was just shot in a bar in Gotham.
Batman reveals he "borrowed" the "Matches" ID from a supposedly dead arsonist. Finding the dying "Matches" at the bar, Batman slips into that persona and sets out to "get" Ventriloquist.

Batman tracks the Ventriloquist, intent on killing him. As the physical conflict goes on, he fights an inner battle between his persona and "Matches". In the end he is able to shrug off the "Matches" persona and just take Ventriloquist into custody.
Batman and Robin travel back in time to the 1860's to investigate the existence of the Black Bat.

As Batman chases Joker's old henchmen through the East End, he begins to wonder whether Bruce Wayne died with his parents long ago. But he comes to realize that even as the Batman he is still Bruce Wayne, the son of Martha and Thomas Wayne.
Batman is seriously injured in an alley and the only one that can save him is The Huntress.
Batman has now recovered from his previous injuries and now must confront Killer Croc to find out the truth about the ransom.
Batman arrives in Metropolis following the trail of Poison Ivy. But Poison Ivy has an unexpected ally in Superman.
Superman is under the control of Poison Ivy and has orders to kill Batman. Now Batman must free his friend from that control and stay alive at the same time.
Bruce Wayne goes to the opera with Selina Kyle, Leslie Thompkins and Thomas Elliot, but Harley Quinn robs the public!  Thomas Elliot won't let himself be robbed.
Batman wants to kill the Joker but is stopped by Jim Gordon.
After the funeral of Thomas Elliot, Batman and Nightwing team up to stop the Riddler.
Batman takes on Ra's al Ghul. Catwoman tries to protect Talia from Lady Shiva.
Robin vs Catwoman, Catwoman vs the Huntress, and Batman vs the Scarecrow. Hush reveals his face, an adult Jason Todd.
Batman fights the adult Jason Todd but finds he's an imposter made of clay.
Batman continues to get information on the Gotham mob families, and how the Penguin is tied into their operations.
The Scarecrow monster attacks the Penguin and his men.  Batman appears on the scene but he is gassed by the Scarecrow monster.

Batman, Nightwing and Batgirl enter the school where mobsters have taken hostages.  Tim Drake has already helped some of his fellow students hide from the criminals and is doing what he can until help arrives.
Zeiss battles Batman and Orpheus.
Bruce, Dick and Alfred discuss the ramifications of the gang war that has just ended in Gotham.  Bruce reveals when and how Tim learned that Spoiler was killed.
Red Hood and Onyx take down some of Black Hand's men. Batman goes to Metropolis to talk to Superman about death.
Batman confronts the Red Hood and learns his true identity.
Killer Croc manages to remove the chip from his brain that the Mad Hatter was using to control him, and he goes looking for the Hatter for revenge.

Batman examines the coffin that Jason Todd was buried in, looking for any clue that would lead him to what happened to Jason's body.  Flashback to history of Batman and Robin during the time when Jason Todd was Robin.
Batman battles Red Hood, while Red Hood attacks Black Mask and his operations.  Deathstroke arrives, offering Red Hood help with his problems.

Deathstroke supplies the villains, Captain Nazi, Hyena and Count Vertigo to take out Red Hood for the Black Mask.  Red Hood and Batman team up to stop the three criminals, but Batman does not approve of Red Hood's methods.

The Black Mask tries to make a deal with Red Hood.  When that doesn't work, Black Mask appears to have killed the Red Hood.  Red Hood sends a message to Alfred in the form of a package containing hair from the Joker.
Harvey Dent and Two-Face battle for control of Harvey's mind and body.
Batman and his son Damian face off against Talia.
Batman puts a stop to Grotesk.
Batman has been badly beaten. Will Robin fare any better?

The members of the Black Glove are shown together and Batman and Robin take the new batmobile for a spin.
Bruce gives Jezebel a tour of the Batcave.  The Black Glove attacks Alfred.
Batman slips further into his Zur-En-Arrh identity, and the Black Glove continues to go after his allies.
Simyan and Mokkari use Lump to steal and record all of Batman's memories.
Batman breaks free of Lump's mind control, disrupting Simyan and Mokkari's cloning program.

Dick Grayson struggles with his decision to take on the mantle of Batman and to take Damian under his wing. He also decides to move his base of operations from the Batcave to the Wayne Foundation building.
Two-Face finds a teleporter who can take him to the Batcave.

Black Mask recruits Dr. Death, Fright and Hugo Strange for his Ministry of Science.
